artifact_downloads.command:
cache_dir='.cache/athena-research/current-shadow-history-github-binary-cache-v1'
restored=false
mapfile -t prime_runs < <(
  gh api \
    "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/current-shadow-history-cache-prime.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=10" \
    --jq '.workflow_runs[] | select(.head_branch == "main") | [.id, .head_sha] | @tsv'
)
for run_row in "${prime_runs[@]}"; do
  IFS=$'\t' read -r run_id run_sha <<< "${run_row}"
  if ! [[ "${run_id}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || ! [[ "${run_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  rm -rf /tmp/athena-current-shadow-history-prime
  mkdir -p /tmp/athena-current-shadow-history-prime
  if gh run download "${run_id}" \
    --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
    --name current-shadow-history-cache-prime \
    --dir /tmp/athena-current-shadow-history-prime >/dev/null 2>&1
  then
    if python -m scripts.restore_current_shadow_history_prime_artifact \
      --artifact-dir /tmp/athena-current-shadow-history-prime \
      --cache-dir "${cache_dir}" \
      --expected-prime-commit-sha "${run_sha}"
    then
      echo "Restored verified durable-history prime artifact from trusted main run ${run_id} at ${run_sha}."
      restored=true
      break
    fi
  fi
done
if [ "${restored}" != true ]; then
  echo "No valid trusted-main durable-history prime artifact was restorable; using verified live transport fallback."
fi
artifact_downloads.step: Restore latest trusted-main durable-history prime artifact

    --jq '.workflow_runs[].id'
)
for run_id in "${prior_runs[@]}"; do
  if [ "${run_id}" = "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" ]; then

  rm -rf /tmp/athena-prior-shadow

  if gh run download "${run_id}" \

    --name current-shadow-all-market-request \
    --dir /tmp/athena-prior-shadow >/dev/null 2>&1
  then
    candidate="$(find /tmp/athena-prior-shadow -type f -name "${state_name}" -print -quit)"
    if [ -n "${candidate}" ]; then
      cp "${candidate}" "${state_path}"
      echo "Restored persistent Shadow identity state from run ${run_id}."

    fi

done
